act: AIFC Conduct of Business Rules (COB), V17

en.title: COB 6.1.1(a) keeps COB 6.2.9 for Market Counterparty transactions, but COB 6.2.1(a) disapplies all of COB 6.2 for them
en.summary: COB 6.1.1(a): COB 6 does not apply to a transaction 'it undertakes with a Market Counterparty, except for COB 6.2.9'. The table in 1.2.7 repeats the exception. COB 6.2.1(a): 'The Rules in COB 6.2 do not apply ... to any transaction which: (a) it undertakes with a Market Counterparty' - with no exception, and 6.2.9 is inside 6.2.
en.correction: Please add "except for COB 6.2.9" to COB 6.2.1(a), as in COB 6.1.1(a) and the table in COB 1.2.7.
